title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO After 33 Years
dek: CFO Colette Kress steps in as interim CEO after a week of scandal.

facts.label: CFO now interim CEO, keeps finance role
Next earnings report under new leaders

caption:
The man who built the AI chip empire is out. Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO, effective immediately. 😮

Nvidia's board announced that Huang is leaving his roles as president, CEO and director after 33 years. CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO, and former Synopsys CEO Harvey C. Jones becomes Nvidia's first-ever board chair. The board gave no reason, but the exit follows an investigation into Huang's relationship with a former Megaspeed executive reported to be a Chinese intelligence asset, plus a New York Times report about a relationship with a direct subordinate.

Why it matters: Nvidia's GPUs power most of today's AI training and inference. The board says the roadmap, including Vera Rubin, continues without interruption, and a search for a permanent CEO is underway. At AI Parabellum we'll be watching the November 17 earnings call closely for clues on strategy and China sales.
